choice_prompt:3:1510690002.text: This mural isn't depicting a worship ceremony at all. It's describing the <style="highlight">ritual steps for banishing a god</style>.
choice_prompt:3:1510690002.source_cn: 这幅壁画描绘的根本不是崇神祭祀，而是<style=highlight>驱逐神的仪式</style>。

say:5:1510690003:0.text: If that's the case, then everything suddenly makes sense.
say:5:1510690003:0.source_cn: 若真是这样，那么一切都能找到合理的解释。
say:5:1510690003:0.male: If that's the case, then everything suddenly makes sense.
say:5:1510690003:0.female: If that's the case, then everything suddenly makes sense.

say:6:1510690004:1.text: When Tully was talking to Sedecim, he kept repeating "he found out". Looking back, "he" must have meant the God of Harvest.
say:6:1510690004:1.source_cn: 塔利在和十六对话时，重复了很多次“被那个家伙发现了”。...

say:7:1510690005:1.text: The people of Tuttleton knew something was wrong with their god, so they tried to use the worship ceremony as a pretense to perform a banishing ritual.
say:7:1510690005:1.source_cn: 图塔人察觉到赛图恩的异常，因此假借祭祀的名义，实施驱逐之行。

say:8:1510690006:0.text: Afraid that Sarethiel would learn of their plans, the people could only communicate through these stone tablets.
say:8:1510690006:0.source_cn: 然而神威在上。图塔人也恐惧真相为丰饶神知晓，所以只敢以...

say:9:1510690007:0.text: And obviously, their plans failed. The God of Harvest discovered what they were up to and just destroyed the entire region with his divine power.
say:9:1510690007:0.source_cn: 很显然，计划失败了。丰饶神发现了他们的目的，干脆用神力...

say:12:1510690008:0.text: What... You really expect me to believe all this nonsense?

say:15:1510690010:0.text: Merlin said the mural depicts a banishing ritual... they were trying to banish the God of Harvest?
say:15:1510690010:0.source_cn: 梅林说，壁画上记录的是驱逐仪式……驱逐丰饶神？

say:16:1510690011:1.text: They blasphemed against a god. Of course they were bringing disaster upon themselves!
say:16:1510690011:1.source_cn: 他们亵渎神明，当然会招来毁灭的灾祸！

say:18:1510690012:1.text: Little emissary, do you remember the needle locusts at Mirehold?
say:18:1510690012:1.source_cn: 小神使，你还记得水泽营地的针蝗吗？

say:19:1510690013:1.text: After the God of Harvest's fall, the skies blackened with locusts. That's when the terrible disasters began.
say:19:1510690013:1.source_cn: 丰饶神神堕后，针蝗漫天，恐怖的灾难就此开始。

say:20:1510690014:1.text: Sarethiel abandoned his people first. The townsfolk were just trying to find a way to survive.
say:20:1510690014:1.source_cn: 是赛图恩先背弃了他的子民。这些凡人只想为自己寻一条生路。

say:22:1510690016:1.text: Take some time to ponder over this, little emissary. Perhaps one day, you'll learn that the world doesn't run on the rules you were taught.
say:22:1510690016:1.source_cn: 慢慢思考吧，小神使，或许有一天，你会发现这个世界运转的...

say:24:1510690017:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come. We should <style="highlight">place the light source on the pedestal</style> and dispel this endless darkness.
say:24:1510690017:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come. We should <style="highlight">place the light source on the pedestal</style> and dispel this endless darkness.
say:24:1510690017:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come. We should <style="highlight">place the light source on the pedestal</style> and dispel this endless darkness.

say:25:1510690018:0.text: Everyone, get ready. I have a feeling the God of Harvest will appear once we do this.
say:25:1510690018:0.source_cn: 大家做好准备，恐怕此举之后，丰饶神就会现身。

say:26:1510690019:0.text: It's almost time... We must face the fallen god head-on.
say:26:1510690019:0.source_cn: 与堕神正面对决的时刻……即将到来。

choice:3:0:1.text: So the priests knew about his fall?
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 难道祭司早就察觉了神堕？
choice:3:0:1.male: So the priests knew about his fall?
choice:3:0:1.female: So the priests knew about his fall?

choice:3:1:2.text: Were they punished for creating light?
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 或许是丰饶神害怕光芒，反而降罪
choice:3:1:2.male: Were they punished for creating light?
choice:3:1:2.female: Were they punished for creating light?
